name: The Lords Prayer
overview: The Lord's Prayer, as taught by Jesus, instructs believers to pray with sincerity and reverence, addressing God as 'Our Father which art in heaven' and honoring His holy name. Prayer should be a private, heartfelt communication with God, avoiding empty repetitions, and trusting in His faithful response to our requests. This prayer models submission to God's will and kingdom, encouraging persistent, Spirit-led supplication for all saints.
